## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the commands run and their actual results, including failures or checks
that were not run. Run `npm run verify` for implementation changes.

## Review notes

- Explain any public API, provider-policy or compatibility change.
- Update affected examples and provider documentation.
- Preserve exact bytes, authentication before parsing and the dependency-free core.
- Use synthetic fixtures; keep credentials and sensitive payloads out of the diff.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for project guidance.
